sources.title: AMD lays off 4% of its workforce | TechCrunch
sources.description: AMD has confirmed that it's laying off 4% of its workforce to focus on 'large growth opportunities.'

sources.title: AMD to lay off 4 pct of its workforce
sources.description: SAN FRANCISCO, Nov. 13 (Xinhua) -- U.S. computer chipmaker AMD is laying off around 1,000 employees, or 4 percent of its workforce, according to the company's annual 10-K filing.
